name: R-97 Quartermaster Droid
description: Developed by Bossikan/Rendili, the R-97 Quartermaster Droid was designed to run storage areas with maximum efficiency. Its four arms helped it to process requisitions quickly, while its legs could extend the height of the droid to three meters, allowing it to reach high shelving. A built-in micro-scanner allowed the droid to keep track of all stores and inventory.

data.name: R-97 Quartermaster Droid
equipment: Domed head with photoreceptors and micro-scanner for inventory
